fillAmount.label: Fill amount
fillAmount.description: How many of each item /fill_stash puts in a slot of a special tab (currency, fragments, essences and the like), up to the slot's own limit.

questPassivePoints.label: Quest passive points
questPassivePoints.description: The passive skill points /make_characters gives a new character for the campaign's quests: 22 from quests and 2 for killing all three bandits.
